answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide to the **best sources for free 3D game assets** in 2026! 🎮

---

## 🏆 Top Free 3D Game Asset Websites

### 1. 🎨 [Kenney.nl](https://kenney.nl)
This one-person operation has released over 40,000 assets — all CC0, all free, no sign-up required. The art style is clean, colorful, and remarkably consistent across packs, which means you can mix and match assets without your game looking inconsistent. The site offers 2D assets, 3D models, UI elements, fonts, and audio. There are also free tools like Asset Forge for creating your own 3D models.

> ✅ **Best for:** Rapid prototyping, consistent art style, UI elements
> 📄 **License:** CC0 (Public Domain)

---

### 2. 🧊 [Quaternius](https://quaternius.com)
If you're making a 3D game with a stylized low-poly look, Quaternius is essential. This Argentinian artist has released thousands of models — characters, animals, vehicles, environments, weapons — all under CC0. The signature "Quaternius style" is instantly recognizable: clean geometry, bright colors, charming animations. Assets come rigged and animated, ready to drop into Unity, Unreal, or Godot.

> ✅ **Best for:** Low-poly 3D games, stylized aesthetics, animated characters
> 📄 **License:** CC0 (Public Domain)

---

### 3. 🌿 [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com)
Poly Haven started as HDRI Haven and has grown into a comprehensive library of 3D models, HDRIs, and textures — all CC0. The models tend toward realistic props and environmental pieces rather than stylized game assets, but they're high quality and instantly usable. No sign-up required — just download what you need.

> ✅ **Best for:** Realistic 3D assets, environment art, lighting/HDRIs
> 📄 **License:** CC0 (Public Domain)

---

### 4. 🖼️ [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com)
Sketchfab is a huge repository of 3D models, and it has a large collection of downloadable assets. While many are for sale, there's a substantial number of models available for free. The platform's built-in 3D viewer is a great feature, allowing you to inspect every angle of a model before you download it. Just be sure to check the licensing for each model, as they can vary.

> ✅ **Best for:** Wide variety of models, previewing before downloading
> 📄 **License:** Varies (CC0, CC BY, etc.)

---

### 5. 🕹️ [itch.io – Game Assets](https://itch.io/game-assets/free/tag-3d)
Itch.io is a popular platform for indie game developers to host and sell their games, but it also has a massive section for game assets. You can find a wide variety of free 3D game assets, from character models to environmental packs, often with very permissive licenses. The community-driven nature of Itch.io means you'll discover unique and creative assets you won't find anywhere else.

> ✅ **Best for:** Unique and creative assets, community packs
> 📄 **License:** Varies per creator

---

### 6. 🧱 [Unity Asset Store (Free)](https://assetstore.unity.com)
The Unity Asset Store offers 10,000+ Unity-optimized assets for free. Unity is one of the world's most popular game engines, so it makes sense that their store is packed full of high-quality resources from every game genre imaginable. 3D is Unity's bread and butter, with 41K assets available. You'll find plenty of low-poly meshes as well as a few pre-made animations.

> ✅ **Best for:** Unity developers, game-ready optimized assets
> 📄 **License:** Unity Store terms

---

### 7. 🎭 [Mixamo](https://mixamo.com)
Mixamo offers 2,000+ free animations with auto-rigging. It's owned by Adobe and is ideal for character animations like walking, running, jumping, and combat moves — perfect for humanoid game characters.

> ✅ **Best for:** Character animations and auto-rigging
> 📄 **License:** Free with Adobe account

---

### 8. 🎃 [OpenGameArt.org](https://opengameart.org)
OpenGameArt has been around for over a decade and hosts a massive collection of 2D art, 3D models, music, and sound effects — all under open licenses like CC0, CC-BY, or GPL.

> ✅ **Best for:** Open-source projects, large variety of genres
> 📄 **License:** CC0, CC-BY, GPL

---

### 9. 📷 [Quixel Megascans](https://quixel.com)
Quixel is releasing a final, offline version of Quixel Mixer, along with the option to download over 800 free Quixel Megascans assets. Quixel is a pioneer in the creation of photogrammetry-based 3D assets, delivering photorealistic models compatible with any engine. All assets are scanned from real-world objects using purpose-built hardware.

> ✅ **Best for:** AAA photorealistic environments, Unreal Engine projects
> 📄 **License:** Free (check current terms)

---

### 10. 🆓 [Free3D.com](https://free3d.com)
A large number of the models have a lower polygon count and can be used in games straight away, covering categories like House, Building, Medieval, Fantasy, City, and more. Free3D also hosts several low-poly models made specifically for real-time game usage.

> ✅ **Best for:** Diverse categories (vehicles, weapons, animals, architecture)
> 📄 **License:** Varies per model

---

## 📋 Quick License Guide

Here's a quick breakdown of common licenses:
- **CC0** – Use commercially ✅ | Modify freely ✅ | No attribution required ✅
- **CC BY** – Use commercially ✅ | Modify freely ✅ | Must credit creator ⚠️
- **CC BY-SA** – Use commercially ✅ | Modify freely ✅ | Must credit + share modifications under same license ⚠️

---

## 💡 Pro Tips
- Choose assets from the same creator or pack (e.g., all Quaternius or all Kenney) and don't mix photorealistic and low-poly cartoon styles.
- GLB/glTF are the recommended formats — all textures, materials, and animations are bundled in one file with native support in Three.js, Babylon.js, Unity, and Unreal Engine.
- Always verify license compatibility before commercial use
